name: HFb_kinetic

summary.T_RH_definition: T of the SM bath (temperature of its energy) when rho_SM = rho_tot/2

history_columns.R_osc_sig: amplitude of the 2 m_sig oscillation of R (3 rho_sig/M_P^2)
history_columns.m_s: spectator mass / H_i (HFa: g_s sqrt(v^2 + rho_chi/m_chi^2); HFb: sqrt(9 - 3R/4))
history_columns.T_SM: temperature of the SM energy (H_i units)
history_columns.m_H2_medium: Higgs asymptotic medium mass^2 kH Tcal^2 (H_i^2)
history_columns.Gamma_th: N-removal rate, energy weighted over all N (H_i): decay + in-medium
history_columns.Gamma_band_N1: occupation-weighted removal rate of in-band N1 (H_i)
history_columns.nbar_band_N1: mean occupation in the band k < mu5,max
history_columns.A_N1: mu5,max/m of the parent for N1
